comments_text: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals this sequence is most similar (60%) to hybrid CM15 K: 38%; L=I: 15%. GRAVY: 0.145; M Wt: 2569.131; M formula: C126H186N36O21S1; Mol ex coeff: 22200. Activity: Active against E. coli ATCC 25922 (MIC 4 uM), S-aureus ATCC 25923 (MIC >64 uM), A. baumannii ATCC 19606 (MIC 2 uM), K. pneumoniae ATCC 700603 (MIC 8 uM), P. aeruginosa ATCC 27853 (MIC 8 uM), S. epidermidis ATCC 12228 (MIC 4 uM). Noticably, this 13mer retained activity against Gram- bacteria similar to PMAP-36. In vitro Toxicity: not toxic (hemo-lytic: ram RBC) at 32 uM. Structure: helical in SDS or TFE.
title: Structural and biological characterization of shortened derivatives of the cathelicidin PMAP-36

comments_text: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals this sequence is most similar (65%) to peptide g K: 25%; I: 20%; V=L=G=P: 10%. Activity: Active against E. coli ATCC 25922 (MIC 2 uM), S. aureus ATCC 25923 (MIC 64 uM), A. baumannii ATCC 19606 (MIC 1 uM), K. pneumoniae ATCC 700603 (MIC 1 uM), P. aeruginosa ATCC 27853 (MIC 4 uM), S. epidermidis ATCC 12228 (MIC 2 uM). In vitro Toxicity: not toxic (hemo-lytic) at 32 uM. Structure: much more helical in SDS or TFE than peptide g, the further shortened one (AP3761). SAR: here helicity is correlated with peptide activity of peptides a (longer) and g (shorter).
title: Structural and biological characterization of shortened derivatives of the cathelicidin PMAP-36
